We calculate the overall recall R by averaging the maximum values of all rows and the overall precision P by averaging the one-to-one precisions ... finally, the overall F1 is computed with R and P. ... The ROBUST Metric ... we first calculate the P/R/F1 scores of the model on each sentence, and then select the scores from the sentence with the worst F1 as the ultimate robustness scores.

guideline: Grammar Correcting: Correct grammatical mistakes in sentences to ensure the fluency. Phrase Replacing: Replace the incorrect phrases in sentences to ensure the correctness. Sentence Rewriting: Rewrite the entire sentence if it has a semantic difference from the original sentence.

Human annotators correct generated paraphrases (grammar, phrase replacement, sentence rewriting) and then annotate N‑ary knowledge tuples following a step‑wise guideline: identify the predicate, find arguments, and optionally add time/location attributes, ensuring completeness, assertedness, informativeness, and atomicity.
All operations are required to preserve both the distinctiveness of the annotation from the original sentence and their semantic equivalence
